signals_info.description: Throttle command used during traction-control operation, with a valid range of 0 to 100 percent.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At all times, the throttle command shall be less than 30 percent.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在所有时刻，油门指令应低于 30%。
nl_Paraphrase_en: While traction control is operating, the commanded throttle shall always remain below 30 percent.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 牵引力控制运行期间，油门指令应始终保持在 30% 以下。
